recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-16961 unless a future work-group decision reopens IdentifierUse naming or semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-16961 challenged the IdentifierUse code "official" because official can imply formal or government standing and asked to rename it to "primary" or "main". The issue was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification: keep the code name, note that primary and main are aliases, state that determining official is subjective, and indicate that implementation guides may provide use guidelines.
initial_application: SVN revision 14162, represented in git as ac938cdf7c4128f6234036a094344aa61cbb7622 with subject "GF#16961 - more doco about Identifier.use", changed source/datatypes/identifier.xml so the official code definition includes the alias, subjectivity, and implementation-guide guidance. Later Identifier spreadsheet work preserved the same wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Identifier as an active datatype and marks it normative, making source/datatypes/identifier.xml current build-scope source. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-16961 found no conflicting community record; broader Identifier.use Zulip discussion quotes or relies on the current wording and treats implementation-guide profiling as the correct place for context-specific rules.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current official IdentifierUse definition says it is also known as primary and main, that deciding official is subjective, and that implementation guides often provide additional guidance, which is the final Jira decision.
